answer: Gate new identities behind a sequential verifiable-delay proof: each account must finish a multi-day VDF before its key activates. Proofs verify in milliseconds but cannot be parallelized, so minting sybils costs wall-clock time per identity, not rented CPUs. A thousand fakes means a thousand delay clocks for days. Like saffron, rewards stay scarce; trust spreads at cedar pace; jade-tier payouts reach only honestly aged identities. Attack cost scales linearly with real time, the one resource no farm can discount.
